title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Academic Speaking Test 4 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Do you have a favourite cafe? [Why/Why not?]
Do you often go to cafes by yourself? [Why/Why not?]
What do you think helps to make a cafe very popular? [Why?]
Why do some people prefer cafes that are part of large chains, rather than small, local cafes?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a place you visited that has beautiful views.
cue_card_bullets: when and why you visited it
what views you can see from this place
and explain why you think these views are so beautiful

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Do you agree that most beauty products are a waste of money?
How does the beauty industry advertise its products so successfully?
What do you think of the view that beauty products should not be advertised to children?
Why do many people equate youth with beauty?
Do you think that being beautiful could affect a person's success in life?
Why might society's ideas about beauty change over time?
